lines: > **pre-flight #288:** ⛔ NOT CAPTURED — UNMEASURED. Reason unchanged from #199…#287: this is a DELEGATED wrap, and the seat that would have priced the ritual before running it is the CONDUCTOR'S, not this one. An estimate invented here would be a number with no estimator behind it [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. The wrap brief's DECLARED FILL at the cut (180,585 real / 27 turns) is the nearest thing to a pre-flight this shape produces, and it is carried on the `wrap-handover` line below rather than re-labelled as one.

> **POST-MORTEM #288 — measured, not narrated.** ⚙ **TWO OBJECTS, REPORTED SEPARATELY, NEVER SUMMED AND NEVER AVERAGED** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]. **(1) THE CONDUCTOR'S WINDOW, first-hand at this seat against `f0d5834b-1313-45d3-9961-2f10be3c3817.jsonl` — the session's TOP-LEVEL transcript, this wrap seat being `subagents/agent-aa9e27e75caeae075.jsonl` beneath it: FILL 197,234 real across 33 turns, peak 197,234, BOOT 74,174 real, 0 compaction records and 0 drops**, read by IMPORTING `_checkin.read_fill` rather than re-implementing it (one definition of the FILL rule, not two). ⛔ **The 180,000 quality line was crossed by 17,234** — ✅ 22,766 inside the ≤220,000 tolerance and **256,000 clear for the sixth session running**. ✅ **The BOOT figure agrees TO THE TOKEN with the conductor's own declaration, and that agreement is what identifies the window as his** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]. ⛔ **74,174 is 4,174 over `BOOT_CEILING_TK` 70,000 — the THIRTEENTH post-diet reading over it, SHRINK-ONLY (`s240-D2` / `s241-D1`), and NOT a re-base**: cut the boot, never raise the number, and raising it is Dave's word alone. ★ **AND IT IS THE THIRD READING ON #286'S BROWSER-BLOCKED SETUP — 73,832 · 74,120 · 74,174, a spread of 342 where the prior seven-reading spread was 11,526 wide** — so the −7,031 connector lever holds as a measured effect at n=3 and the figure is stated ONCE, here, per `s241-D2`. **(2) THE DELEGATED SEATS are the `subs` line below and are QUOTA, never FILL** [[budget-vs-quota-vocabulary]].

> **⚠ THE `subs` LINE ABOVE IS QUOTA, NEVER FILL** [[budget-vs-quota-vocabulary]] — five delegated Opus seats, every one an `Agent` at `spawnDepth 1`, model opus, NONE in seat: M 162,304 · B 177,908 · A 174,021 · T 190,369 · P 299,493, the harness's per-agent figures as the conductor DECLARED them in the wrap brief. ⚠ **AND THE SECOND DEFINITION IS PUBLISHED BESIDE IT RATHER THAN RECONCILED AWAY, FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE WRAP.** Read with `_checkin.read_fill` — input side only, the ONE definition of FILL this repo has — the same five seats sum to **998,602** (M 161,333 · B 176,769 · A 172,457 · T 189,501 · P 298,542). **The gap is 5,493 and it is exactly each lane's final-turn `output_tokens`, matching on every one of the five: 971 · 1,139 · 1,564 · 868 · 951.** ⇒ **Which definition this line means is ruling-shaped and is HIS** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]. ⚠ **A SIXTH SUB — this wrap seat itself — is EXCLUDED BY DECLARATION and no placeholder is written for it:** its own total cannot be final from inside itself, and `s214-D5` forbids turning an unknown into a number [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]].

> **wrap-handover: brief-cut 180,585 real (conductor, DECLARED in the #288 wrap brief, 27 turns) · sub-cut 197,234 real (first-hand at this seat, same transcript, 33 turns) · delta 16,649 real · replay unobservable (conductor-side, post-wrap)**

> **⚠ THE `delta` ABOVE IS A LEGAL SUBTRACTION AND THE NAMED WINDOW IS WHY.** The `s214-D5` clause homed at the #272 wrap says `delta` is meaningful only when both terms read the SAME window: `brief-cut` is the conductor's DECLARED FILL and `sub-cut` is this seat's `_checkin.read_fill` reading of **that same transcript**, `f0d5834b-1313-45d3-9961-2f10be3c3817.jsonl`, identified independently by its BOOT reading back to the token. ⚠ **16,649 is the LARGEST hand-over on this run and the cause is nameable rather than mysterious: six further conductor turns landed after the brief was cut** — the DAVE-RULINGS file, the brief itself and the lane reconcile all post-date it. ⛔ **`replay` is NOT observable from inside the sub and is NOT guessed**; the conductor may append the measured figure at the #289 opener.

> **⚠ DECLARED SKIPS AND NOT-DONE AT THIS WRAP, EACH NAMED WITH ITS SIZE** (declare-last, and the size is the point). **2c, 2d, 2e and 2f ALL RAN**, so the `size:` stamp in `GOOD-MORNING.md`'s header is **THIS session's own measurement and not #287's** — re-measured after every move landed and iterated to a fixed point. **2e was a NO-OP at 0 lines.** **NOT DONE and named rather than implied:** the `knowledge/_render/seat_env.sh` one-line playwright glob fix (lane B symlinked around it, lane T could not render); the showroom re-sync after lane A's arm; a `--check` arm for `dashboard/index.html`; and the four generators fenced by the brief (`gen_kg_rules.py`, `land_rests_on.py`, `gen_kg_icons.py`, `_build_all.py`) were **not run by declaration**, so the two REGEN-SERIAL advisory warns stand uncleared exactly as at #287.
> **section-usage #288 (self-report, delegated OPUS 5 wrap sub):** GM HDR:C LATEST:C PRIOR:R DOFIRST:U A:U C1:U C2:U C4:U STRATA:C · LS HDR:C LATEST:C PRIOR:R REST:U

> The wrap WROTE the header, the ★ LATEST banner, the ⏱ delta and the strata; READ the ★ PRIOR (#286) banner to roll it and to run the 2c EXIT CHECK over it, the #285 ⏱ delta to run 2d's, and the #287 stratum to run 2f's; and left §A, DO-FIRST, §C and the standing `_LIVE-STATE` regions UNREAD and UNTOUCHED. ⚠ **§A was not read and was not edited — it is standing and exempt (GM-D7-am), and the mover asserts its sha256 before and after every projected write, so the claim is mechanical rather than an assurance.**

> **consult-receipts #288:** none — `_memento_search.py` was not run at this seat. ⚠ **The honest negative, and the reason is the same as #287's:** every artefact this ritual needed was named by path in the wrap brief or found by `git status`, so a retrieval query would have been a ceremony rather than a consultation. ⛔ **An invented receipt would poison the only dataset that can ever answer whether the KG is used** [[instrument-without-a-consumer]].

> **⚠ THE `section-sizes` LINE BELOW IS `_gm_usage.py`'s INSTRUMENT AND IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT FROM THE `size:` STAMP'S WHOLE-FILE `tiktoken` MEASUREMENT** — the two are never reconciled and never averaged [[measure-dont-convert-units]].

> **⚠ `s214-D6` BANNER-DISCIPLINE MEASUREMENT — QUOTED FROM `_CHAIN.md`'s GENERATED FOOTER, NEVER RE-DERIVED, AND TAKEN AFTER THE DECLARE-LAST `size:` STAMP BECAUSE THE STAMP IS ITSELF INSIDE THE CHAIN SLICE** (the #241 rule, from #240's one-wrap-two-figures lesson): {{CHAIN}}

> **⚠ AND THE BANNER'S HEADROOM, MEASURED RATHER THAN FEARED — THIS IS THE SEVENTH WRAP RUNNING TO SAY SO.** The ★ LATEST banner closed at **{{BANNER}}** against the `s241-D2` cap of 1,200 / 10, measured with the GATE'S OWN instrument (`_capture_gate.measure_tokens`) so the pre-check and the gate cannot disagree, and with the **GENERATED residual line substituted from `_roll_state.py` before measuring**, because that line sits inside the block the cap charges. ⛔ **IT DID NOT FIT ON THE FIRST PASS AND THE REPAIR IS NAMED: the first draft measured 1,250 and was compressed to fit by tightening sentences, NEVER by dropping an item, a carry, a declared skip or a receipt name** — which is exactly what `s214-D6` commands (*"SHORTER, never decide-what-to-drop"*). ★ **What made it tight is that #288 DISCHARGED almost nothing and ACCRUED seventeen carries** — the inverse of #287, whose four closures paid for its fit. ⛔ **THE STANDING WARNING IS NOT WITHDRAWN and the cap is Dave's.**

> **COMMIT STATE #288:** ⬛ **THE HASH IS A DECLARED GAP IN THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE — A COMMIT CANNOT NAME ITSELF.** This wrap's commit sha, its push verdict verbatim and its CI read are delivered in the returned report and in the filed report `notes/_subreports/2026-09-19-288-W2-wrap.md`, and the sha is readable from `git log`. ⛔ **THE TREE WAS NOT IN SYNC WHEN THIS RITUAL OPENED AND #288 HAS NO LANE COMMIT AT ALL — THIS WRAP IS THE SESSION'S ONLY COMMIT.** At the open `git status --porcelain` read **9 modified and 5 untracked paths** against HEAD `4cc8b37a`, and every one is accounted for: lane A's four edited files (`knowledge/canon/canon.css`, `knowledge/snippets/Template-dashboard-bento.reference.html`, `knowledge/components/template-dashboard-bento.meta.json`, and the new `knowledge/canon/gen_bento_role_vars.py`), lane M's `notes/_STRAND-MAP-2026-09-19.html`, the whole of `notes/_lanes/288/`, the five filed lane reports, `knowledge/_state.json` (the lane rows), `knowledge/_THEME-PROVENANCE-GATE.md` and `knowledge/_graph-mark-observations.jsonl` (instrumentation appends), and ⚠ **THREE PATHS INHERITED DIRTY FROM #287 AND COMMITTED HERE: `notes/_REHEARSAL-LOG.jsonl`, `notes/_dream/_GRADE-DECISIONS.jsonl`, and `notes/_lanes/287/DAVE-RULINGS-2026-09-19.md` with six lines appended AFTER #287's commit — the wrong-order class, THIRD consecutive session.** ⛔ **SIX BLOCKING GATE FAILS STAND AND THIS COMMIT TAKES THE `#243` DECLARED NOT-A-WRAP PATH — THE FOURTEENTH CONSECUTIVE WRAP TO DO SO.** Every one is another session's append-only testimony in `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` — the boot-drift CEILING BREACH and five boot double-counts (#243 ×5, #264, #272, #273, #274) — and **a wrap may not repair an inherited gate fail**: the ceiling's remedy is to CUT THE BOOT, never to raise the literal [[gate-must-quote-what-it-forbids]]. ⚠ **INSTRUMENTATION APPENDS stood in the tree at the brief cut and more accrued DURING this ritual**, because `_checkin.py` and the wrap gate write to them as they run; they are committed with this wrap and named here, exactly as #282…#287 did, and **the POLICY on them is still Dave's (dream pass 6 P2, floated)**. ⚠ **ONE THING ABOUT THE SESSION'S SHAPE IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT WILL RECUR: FIVE LANES RAN, NONE IN SEAT, AND NOT ONE OF THEM COMMITTED** — #287's clean single-invocation commit lane was not repeated, so every gate this wrap must drive green was driven at the wrap seat under wrap heat rather than by a lane with budget to spare. ★ **The difference is worth naming because #287's report named the cause of its own clean run: a commit lane that reads the prior lane's report first.** ⚠ **A STRAY WAS MOVED, NEVER DELETED:** `knowledge/_screen-gate/composed-dashboard.md`, written by lane P's `_validate_screen.py` run, went to `_to_delete/288-P-stray/` by `mv` (the #284 / #286 / #287 precedent), with `.gitignore` untouched and nothing excluded from staging. ⛔ **`_to_delete/` is an accumulating squatter that `4c` does not reach, and what to do about it is his.**
